title: Graph-based chain construction API for gf2-sim
description:
## Goal

Lower-level graph API for novel-chain construction:
`Chain::new().add_stage().connect(a, b)`. Runtime type-check on
connector compatibility; supports branching DAG topology (fan-out
and fan-in, no cycles).

## Context

Task under story `bcf7776d` (CPU foundation for gf2-sim
pipeline) within epic `gf2-sim` (`f9717e7e`). Placeholder body —
project-lead expands during claim.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Project-lead expands this section with verifiable
  acceptance conditions consistent with the parent story's
  deliverables and the epic's architecture contract.
- [hard] Same DVB-T2 chain expressible via the graph API
  produces output matching the typestate-builder preset.

## Non-goals

See epic `f9717e7e` non-goals; turbo / feedback-loop topology
is out of scope.
